newsitem.title: UK: RAISIO EXPECTS CAPITAL BOOST LONGER TERM.
newsitem.headline: RAISIO EXPECTS CAPITAL BOOST LONGER TERM.

text.p: Finnish food, animal feed and chemicals group Raision Tehtaat Oy expects a share capital increase longer term as it develops its cholesterol-reducing Benecol product, a senior executive said on Thursday.
"Of course, we must increase out share capital ... in the long run," deputy chief executive Jukka Maki told Reuters Financial Television in an interview.

Asked when Raisio expected to see real growth in profit on the product, he said: "I think we will have to wait another one and a half years -- something like that -- before we can see a real profit-maker. Now we are investing so much," he said.

Asked if he expected further acquisitions from Raisio to develop the product, he said, "I should say no." Raisio's strategy had for years focussed on being a number two player in the Baltic area, which it now was, he said.
Raisio said earlier this week it had bought a Swedish margarine company which would offer an immediate outlet for Benecol, currently on sale only in Finland, in margarine form.
